BrochureContent.Content:
Thomas Byrne Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this superb semi-detached property in a much sought after residential area, on the northside of Drogheda.

The accommodation which comprises: Entrance Hallway, Sitting Room, Kitchen/Dining Room, 3 Bedrooms(Main En-Suite) and a Bathroom. There is natural gas central heating and double glazed windows. The property benefits from driveway and garden to the front and side access to large landscaped rear garden with block built shed.

Located just off the Termonfeckin Road, this property is within easy reach of a host of local amenities such as schools, shops, restaurants, etc. For the commuter, the M1 motorway is easily accessible, and the property is on a local bus route. Fantastic opportunity to acquire a superb property in a very popular location. 
Viewing highly recommended
